scope: A newly created, empty PostgreSQL 16.13 candidate database only

checks.name: full_schema_migration
checks.meaning: A fresh database reached the current schema through the normal migration chain.

checks.name: column_preserving_restore
checks.meaning: A signed tenant record was admitted only in a serializable, exclusively locked, otherwise empty 39-table target and read back as exactly one row.

checks.name: cleanup
checks.meaning: The schema was downgraded to base and the temporary PostgreSQL container was removed.

nonclaims: No Eva1 or managed-B database, volume, Hindsight bank, secret, Telegram route, or Home Assistant route was opened, mounted, changed, or restarted.
This restored only one synthetic column-preserving record; it is not a full portable-backup restore.
Real portable backups containing redacted connector or credential records still fail before the first target write until the separate re-authorisation importer exists.
Object-CAS restoration, second-machine recovery, update, and A/B acceptance remain open.
